response:
When anxiety feels overwhelming and your thoughts are racing, wanting immediate relief is completely understandable. One of the fastest ways to signal safety to your brain is through your breath. Try inhaling slowly through your nose for four seconds, holding for four, and exhaling through your mouth for six seconds. Repeating this can help slow your heart rate. Another quick physical reset is splashing cold water on your face or holding a piece of ice, which can help interrupt the anxiety loop. 

You can also try grounding yourself to pull your focus away from your racing mind and into the present room. Look around and name five things you can see, four things you can feel, three things you can hear, two things you can smell, and one thing you can taste. Please remember to be gentle with yourself right now. Fighting the thoughts often makes them louder, so just focus on anchoring your body in the present moment until the wave of anxiety passes.
